data.exact_reserve_text: The profit on the technical account of GBP 210.3m (2022: profit GBP 9.7m) includes a run-off deficit of GBP 20.6m for prior accident years (2022: GBP 43.9m deficit). This included a deficit of GBP 10.9m for reinsurance acceptance business and a deficit of GBP 9.7m on direct business (2022: deficit of GBP 40.4m for reinsurance acceptance business and a deficit of GBP 3.5m on direct business).

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross run-off deficit of GBP 20.6 million for prior accident years in 2023, indicating a strengthening of reserves. This was primarily driven by adverse development in the Marine Liability class, attributed to increasing personal injury claims costs and social inflation, as well as adjustments to expected loss ratios and development patterns. The syndicate also noted the impact of higher inflation over the past two years on its reserving approach.
